'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
****Six people are reported injured in an alleged shelling attack on [[Klintsy]], [[Bryansk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-injured-shelling-russian-town-bordering-ukraine-official-says-2022-06-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ethiopian civil conflict (2018–present)|Ethiopian civil conflict]]
**In a joint operation, the [[Oromo Liberation Army]] and the Gambela Liberation Front launch an attack on the regional capital of [[Gambela (city)|Gambela city]]. The fighting lasted for several hours before security forces were able to recapture the city from the rebels, with heavy casualties reported on both sides. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-61177536 (BBC News)] [https://addisstandard.com/update-gambella-state-says-security-forces-stabilize-capital-city-after-hours-long-fighting-against-joint-gambella-oromo-rebels/ (''Addis Standard'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Ten people are killed and three others are injured in a shootout between security forces and suspected criminals in [[Texcaltitlán]], [[State of Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ten-killed-mexico-state-shootout-with-security-forces-officials-say-2022-06-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**A [[Tajikistan|Tajik]] [[Tajik Border Troops|border guard]] is killed and three others are injured in a clash with [[Kyrgyzstan]] [[State Border Guard Service of Kyrgyzstan|border troops]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/one-killed-tajik-kyrgyz-border-guard-clash-sources-2022-06-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Decommunization]]
**[[Finland|Finnish]] authorities remove the country's [[List of statues of Vladimir Lenin#Finland|last remaining monument]] of [[Soviet Union]] founder and leader [[Vladimir Lenin]] in [[Kotka]], [[Kymenlaakso]], relocating the 1979 gift from the [[Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic]] to a museum. [https://yle.fi/news/3-12492284 (Yle)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian war|International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**The [[European Union]] removes [[Russia]]'s largest bank [[Sberbank]], the [[Russian Agricultural Bank]] and the [[Credit Bank of Moscow]] from the [[SWIFT]] international payments system as part of another round of [[economic sanctions]] on Russia over its invasion of Ukraine. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/3506578-eu-removes-three-more-russian-banks-from-swift.html (Ukrinform)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[government of Kiribati]] declares a [[state of disaster]] due to severe [[drought]] in the country. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/469075/kiribati-govt-declares-state-of-disaster-due-to-severe-drought (RNZ)]
*An explosion at a chemical factory in [[Firouzabad]], [[Fars province|Fars]], [[Iran]], injures 103 people. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-business-explosions-iran-fires-181b63574b4a53990812f2be2ad784a6 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Spain]] removes all [[COVID-19]] entry requirements for anyone arriving into the country from the [[European Union]] or the [[Schengen Area]]. However, travellers from outside the EU will still need to be fully vaccinated or provide proof of a negative [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR test]] within 72 hours before departure in order to enter Spain. [https://www.euronews.com/travel/2022/06/06/spain-travel-restrictions-covid-tests-vaxx-rules-and-masks-explained-in-full (Euronews)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] announces plans to officially rename the [[monkeypox]] virus in order to combat [[Social stigma|stigma]] and [[racism]] surrounding the disease. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-06-13/who-weighs-renaming-monkeypox-virus-to-minimize-stigma-racism (Bloomberg)]
*[[Polio eradication]], [[Polio in Pakistan]]
**[[Pakistan]] reports its 10th case of [[polio]] this year after two more cases of the virus are reported in [[North Waziristan District]]. [https://arynews.tv/pakistan-reports-tenth-polio-case-of-2022/ (ARY News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Denmark relations]]
**[[Whisky War]]
***The Danish Foreign Ministry announces that it has reached a deal with [[Canada]] to divide the long-disputed [[Hans Island]] in the [[Arctic]] in half between Canada's [[Nunavut]] territory and [[Greenland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canada-denmark-divide-small-arctic-island-ending-ownership-dispute-2022-06-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in Germany]]
**The [[Federal Ministry of Health (Germany)|Federal Ministry of Health]] says that it will hold consultations with over 200 representatives from medical, legal and other fields on legalizing the sale of [[cannabis (drug)|cannabis]] in licensed shops for recreational purposes. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/germany-moves-ahead-plan-legalize-cannabis-sales-85355542 (AP via ABC News)]
*A [[Cambodia|Cambodian]] court [[criminal conviction|convicts]] 60 members of the former [[Cambodia National Rescue Party]] of [[treason]], including [[Cambodian-American]] lawyer [[Theary Seng]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/cambodian-court-set-rule-treason-trial-dissidents-85373703 (AP via ABC News)]
*Police in [[Ecuador]] arrest an indigenous leader after incidents that occurred during recent protests against the economic policies of president [[Guillermo Lasso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuadorean-police-detain-indigenous-leader-after-road-blockades-2022-06-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**The [[United States Tennis Association]] says that tennis players from [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] will be allowed to compete at the [[2022 US Open (tennis)|upcoming]] [[US Open (tennis)|US Open]] tournament despite the ongoing invasion of [[Ukraine]], which is expected to be held in [[New York (state)|New York]] after [[The Championships, Wimbledon|Wimbledon]] banned them from doing so. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/jun/14/us-open-will-allow-russian-and-belarusian-players-after-wimbledon-ban (''The Guardian'')]
